trigger.trigger_text: Autonomous monitor: 8 cards share 1 unusual device profile(s) between 2016-11-01 and 2016-11-15 (50% New-to-account, 62% behind a proxy). Review transaction 3431638 on card C07164-K1.

evidence.claim: Customer denied the activity when asked (simulated reply; see evidence_requests)
Analyst flagged purchases from the same unusual device profile on several cards
Of the 8 closed episodes closest in behavioural fingerprint, 8 were confirmed fraud (mostly card_not_present_fraud) and 0 were cleared (history base rate: 84% of closed cases are fraud)
Case-memory model (trained only on the bank's closed cases, out-of-time AUC 0.92) puts transaction 3431638 at 0.63; the bank's risk score is 0.36. Both are inputs, not a verdict

case.summary: Transaction 3431638 ($14.93) on card C07164-K1 was flagged for review due to the use of an anonymous proxy and an unusual device profile. The cardholder, C07164, denied making the purchase and failed a subsequent step-up authentication challenge. Analysis of similar prior cases, including CC-3601 and CC-3446, supports a verdict of card-not-present fraud. The investigation concluded with a card block to mitigate further risk.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer replies that they did not make the flagged purchase and still has the card
One-time passcode sent to the registered phone was not completed; the session was abandoned

initial.reason: R1: require a one-time passcode on further online activity
R1: probability 0.72 rests on a single signal; verify before any block
Section 3a: fraud probability >= 0.30 or evidence requested
Keep the card active under raised monitoring while verification is pending

final.reason: R2: customer denies the transaction; exposure $14.93 <= $2,500 so route L1
Section 3a / R2: fraud probability above 0.30; open the internal case and write it to the graph

next_best_actions.what_changed: The fraud probability rose from 0.72 to 0.96 following the customer's denial of the transaction and the abandoned step-up authentication session.

sar.reason: Case only, no report: exposure $14.93 is under $1,000, no shared device, region cluster or link to another customer's fraud, and the pattern is documented (section 3a).

stop_reason: Per policy R2 and section 6, the card was blocked after the customer denied the transaction; no SAR is required as the $14.93 exposure is below the $1,000 threshold.
